newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE BREAKS ESTORIL TRACK RECORD.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE BREAKS ESTORIL TRACK RECORD.

text.p: Jacques Villeneuve broke the Estoril lap record after a thrilling battle with the Benetton pair of Gerhard Berger and Jean Alesi in pre-season testing on Tuesday.
The Canadian, favourite for this year's Formula One world championship, clocked one minute 18.36 seconds in his Williams during his final run of the day to eclipse Berger's time of 1:18.66.
Alesi was third quickest on 1:18.75, followed by German Heinz-Harald Frentzen's Williams (1:19.52) and German Ralf Schumacher's Jordan (1:19.76).
All five drivers were below Damon Hill's pole position time of 1:20.330 for last year's Portuguese Grand Prix.
